newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes regain strength, LLS attracts refiners.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes regain strength, LLS attracts refiners.

text.p: U.S. cash crude prices found some relief from recent bearish tendencies, gaining ground Thursday for outright and domestic grade differential prices.
Outright cash tracked a resurgent futures market, where prices rose in sympathy with a heating oil rally due to cold temperatures across the northeastern United States.
May West Texas Intermediate/Cushing talked late in the session 30 cents higher from Wednesday, at $19.55-65 a barrel. May/June WTI spreads remained around 12 cts in June's favor.
Differentials were active in Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James, where barrels sold at discounts between 30-32 cts.
